Privacy policy

Last updated November 25, 2026.

ShelterDayOut is a program of Charity Good (charitygood.org). This policy explains what we collect on the site and how we use it.

What we collect

You can browse ShelterDayOut without giving us any personal information. If you send a form, we collect what you enter, such as your name, email, phone and message. Our web host keeps standard server logs (like IP address and pages visited) for security and basic traffic counts.

How we use it

We use form details only to respond to you, update listings, and run the site. If you send an outing request, we send it to the shelter you chose so they can contact you, and keep a copy in case there's a problem. Shelters handle your information under their own policies.

What we don't do

We don't sell or rent personal information, and we don't use advertising trackers.

Keeping and deleting

We keep form messages only as long as needed to run the site. To see or delete what you sent us, email hello@shelterdayout.com.

Children

The site isn't directed to children under 13, and outing requests require you to be 18 or older.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
